title: Hip Belt detailed design spec
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The Hip Belt is the core product, described only conceptually (wide, semi-rigid, low on the pelvis, position marker REQ-F4). Depends on: ridebelt-anthro-001, ridebelt-materials-001 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write a detailed spec: width, contour, stiffener, padding, closure, tether attachment points and angles, position guide, sizes (from anthro-001), materials (from materials-001) and bill of materials.
